blocks.text: This  report  presents  a  comprehensive  overview  of  the  employee  benefits  programme  administered  by Acme Corp during the financial year 2026. The data covers health insurance enrollment, leave utilisation, training participation, and compensation benchmarks across all four regional offices. Key findings indica a 12% increase in health plan uptake and a reduction in average sick-leave days from 6.4 to 5.1 per employee per annum. Detailed breakdowns are provided in the tables and figures below.

All permanent employees are entitled to paid leave as outlined in the company policy document (Ref: HR-POL-2024-03). Leave accrues at a rate of 1.75 days per month of continuous service. The following table summarises entitlements by employment grade.

The following image is a scanned copy of the internal budget approval memo referenced in section 4.2 of this report. It contains handwritten annotations and a reference number for audit trail purposes.

items: Bangalore office leads enrollment at 97.1%, up from 94.2% in Q4 2025.
Average sick leave per employee declined by 20% year-on-year.
Maternity and paternity uptake increased by 34% following the revised policy.
Study leave utilisation remains low at 38% of entitled days - awareness campaign planned.
Grade 5 Directors reported the highest leave balance carryover (avg 8.2 days).
